description: This file defines a REST API for managing tasks in the Superset project, including endpoints for retrieving task details, checking task status, canceling tasks, and listing task subscribers.

classes.name: TaskRestApi
classes.description: REST API class for task management, providing endpoints for task retrieval, status, cancellation, and related subscribers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific task by UUID.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieve the current status of a specific task.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancel a specific task, with logic to handle different cancellation scenarios.

methods.name: _execute_cancel
methods.description: Internal method to execute task cancellation with error handling.

methods.name: _run_cancel_command
methods.description: Parse request data and run the cancel command.

methods.name: _build_cancel_response
methods.description: Construct the response after a cancel operation.

methods.name: related_subscribers
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users subscribed to tasks for filtering purposes.
